entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you're speaking with VeloFit. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David... *sigh* I'm calling because I need to return something. It's the new cycling shoes I bought. I'm just so disappointed.

I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed with your purchase. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more about the fit and feel?

It's the fit. I've tried everything. I adjusted the cleats a dozen times, wore different socks... but no matter what, they give me terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I saved up for these... I really needed them to work.
I can certainly understand your frustration. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the shoes were delivered about 18 days ago. Let me just confirm our return policy.
Alright, I've got good news. Our policy allows for returns on items like these for up to 90 days. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? You can? That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them, and I really needed this money back. Thank you so much, David.

You are very welcome. I'm happy to help. I am processing that for you now and I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label. Just package the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives them.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making this so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
